algorithms.html: The duration attribute’s getter steps are:

steps.html: If this’s paintTime is not 0, then return the duration between this’s startTime and this’s paintTime.
Return the duration between this’s startTime and the relative high resolution time given this’s timing info’s end time and this’s relevant global object.

algorithms.html: The firstUIEventTimestamp attribute’s getter steps are:

steps.html: Let timestamp be this’s timing info’s first ui event timestamp.
If timestamp is null, then return 0.
Return the relative high resolution coarse time given timestamp and this’s relevant global object.

algorithms.html: The blockingDuration attribute’s getter steps are:

steps.html: Let sortedTaskDurations be this’s timing info’s task durations, sorted in descending order.
If this’s timing info’s update the rendering start time is not zero, then:
Let renderEndTime be this’s paintTime if this’s paintTime is not 0; otherwise the relative high resolution time given this’s timing info’s end time and this’s relevant global object.
Let renderDuration be the duration between this’s renderStart and renderEndTime.
If sortedTaskDurations is empty, then append renderDuration to sortedTaskDurations.
Otherwise, increment sortedTaskDurations[0] by renderDuration.
Let totalBlockingDuration be 0.
For each duration in sortedTaskDurations, if duration is greater than 50 then increment totalBlockingDuration by duration - 50.
Return totalBlockingDuration.

algorithms.html: The scripts attribute’s getter steps are:

steps.html: Let scripts be a list « ».
Let entryWindow be this’s relevant global object.
For each scriptInfo in this’s frame timing info’s scripts:
Let scriptWindow be scriptInfo’s window.

Let scriptEntry be a new PerformanceScriptTiming in this’s relevant realm, whose timing info is scriptInfo and whose window attribution is the value corresponding to the first matching statement:

scriptWindow is undefined or scriptWindow’s associated Document is not fully active

other

scriptWindow is entryWindow

self

entryWindow’s associated Document’s node navigable’s ancestor navigables contains scriptWindow’s associated Document’s node navigable

ancestor

scriptWindow’s associated Document’s node navigable’s ancestor navigables contains entryWindow’s associated Document’s node navigable

descendant

entryWindow’s associated Document’s node navigable’s top-level traversable is scriptWindow’s associated Document’s node navigable’s top-level traversable

same-page

Otherwise

other.
Append scriptEntry to scripts.
Return scripts.

algorithms.html: The invoker attribute’s getter steps are:

steps.html:
Switch on this’s invokerType:

"`classic-script`"
"`module-script`"

Return this’s timing info’s source url.

"`event-listener`"
"`user-callback`"

Return this’s timing info’s invoker name.

"`resolve-promise`"
"`reject-promise`"
Let targetName be this’s timing info’s invoker name.
If this’s timing info’s event target element id is not the empty string, then: Set targetName to the concatenation of « targetName, "#", this’s timing info’s event target element id ».

Otherwise, if this’s timing info’s event target element src attribute is not the empty string, then: Set targetName to the concatenation of « targetName, "[src=\"", this’s timing info’s event target element src attribute, "\"]" ».
Return the concatenation of « targetName, ".on", this’s timing info’s event type ».
Let thenOrCatch be "`then`" if this’s invokerType is "`resolve-promise`"; otherwise "`catch`".
Return the concatenation of « this’s timing info’s invoker name, ".", thenOrCatch ».

algorithms.html: The window attribute’s getter steps are:

steps.html: Let window be the result of calling deref on this’s timing info’s window.
If window is undefined or window’s associated Document is not fully active, then return null; otherwise return window.

algorithms.name: Accessing the frame timing info
algorithms.html:
To get the nearest same-origin root for a Document document:

The relevant frame timing info for a Document document is its nearest same-origin root’s current frame timing info.

steps.html: Let ancestors be the ancestor navigables of document.

For each ancestorNavigable in ancestors: If ancestorNavigable’s active document’s origin is same origin with document’s origin, and ancestorNavigable’s active document’s relevant agent is document’s relevant agent, then return ancestorNavigable’s active document.
Return document.

algorithms.name: Record if needed
algorithms.html: To start recording task time if needed given an environment settings object settingsObject:

steps.html: If settingsObject’s global object is not a Window, then return false.
Let document be settingsObject’s global object’s associated Document.
If document’s relevant frame timing info is non-null, then return false.
Record task start time given the unsafe shared current time and document.
Return true if document’s relevant frame timing info is non-null; otherwise false.

algorithms.name: Record task start time
algorithms.html: To record task start time given a DOMHighResTimeStamp unsafeTaskStartTime, and a Document document:

steps.html: If document is not fully active or document’s visibility state is "`hidden`", then return.
Let root be document’s nearest same-origin root.
If root is not fully active or root’s visibility state is "`hidden`", then return.

If root’s current frame timing info is null, then set root’s current frame timing info to a new frame timing info whose start time is unsafeTaskStartTime, and whose cross-origin isolated capability is root’s relevant settings object’s cross-origin isolated capability.
Set root’s current frame timing info’s current task start time to unsafeTaskStartTime.

algorithms.name: Report task end time
algorithms.html: To record task end time given a DOMHighResTimeStamp unsafeTaskEndTime, and a Document document:

steps.html: Let timingInfo be document’s relevant frame timing info.
If timingInfo is null, then return.
Let global be document’s relevant global object.
Let safeTaskEndTime be the relative high resolution time given unsafeTaskEndTime and global.
Let safeTaskStartTime be the relative high resolution time given timingInfo’s current task start time and global.
Append the duration between safeTaskStartTime and safeTaskEndTime to timingInfo’s task durations.
If the user agent believes that updating the rendering of document’s node navigable would have no visible effect, then:
Set document’s nearest same-origin root’s current frame timing info to null.
Set timingInfo’s end time to unsafeTaskEndTime.
Let frameDuration be the duration between the relative high resolution time given timingInfo’s start time and global, and safeTaskEndTime.
If frameDuration is equal or greater than 50 milliseconds, then queue a long animation frame entry given document, timingInfo, and a new paint timing info.

algorithms.name: Record rendering time
algorithms.html: To record rendering time given a Document document, and a DOMHighResTimeStamp unsafeStyleAndLayoutStart:

steps.html: Let root be document’s nearest same-origin root.
Let timingInfo be root’s current frame timing info.
If timingInfo is null, then return.
Assert: timingInfo’s style and layout stack is empty.
Let global be root’s relevant global object.
Let frameDuration be the duration between the relative high resolution time given timingInfo’s start time and global, and the current high resolution time given global.
If frameDuration is less than 50 milliseconds, then set root’s current frame timing info to null and return.
Set timingInfo’s update the rendering start time to timingInfo’s current task start time.
Set timingInfo’s style and layout start time to unsafeStyleAndLayoutStart.
Let styleAndLayoutStart be the result of coarsening unsafeStyleAndLayoutStart given timingInfo’s cross-origin isolated capability.
For each period of timingInfo’s style and layout periods whose start time is greater than or equal to styleAndLayoutStart:
Let duration be the duration between period’s start time and period’s end time.
If period’s type is "`style`", then increment timingInfo’s style duration by the milliseconds value of duration.
Otherwise, increment timingInfo’s layout duration by the milliseconds value of duration.
Empty timingInfo’s style and layout periods.
If root’s browsing context is not paint-timing eligible, then:
Set root’s current frame timing info to null.
Set timingInfo’s end time to the unsafe shared current time.
Queue a long animation frame entry given root, timingInfo, and a new paint timing info.

algorithms.name: Queue frame timing
algorithms.html: To queue a long animation frame entry given a Document document, a frame timing info timingInfo, and a paint timing info paintTimingInfo:

steps.html: Assert: timingInfo’s style and layout stack is empty.
Queue a new PerformanceLongAnimationFrameTiming in document’s relevant realm, whose timing info is timingInfo and whose paint timing info is paintTimingInfo.

algorithms.name: Report pending user callback
algorithms.html: To record timing info for user callback given a callback function callback and an environment settings object settings: Create script entry point given settings, "`user-callback`", and the following steps given a script timing info scriptTimingInfo:

steps.html: Set scriptTimingInfo’s invoker name to callback’s identifier.
Apply source location for scriptTimingInfo given callback.

algorithms.name: Report pending timer
algorithms.html: To record timing info for timer handler given a string or Function handler, an environment settings object settings, and a boolean repeat: Create script entry point given settings, "`user-callback`", and the following steps given a script timing info scriptTimingInfo:

steps.html: Let setTimeoutOrInterval be "setInterval" if repeat is true, "setTimeout" otherwise.
Set scriptTimingInfo’s invoker name to concatenation of « TimerHandler:", setTimeoutOrInterval ».
If handler is a Function, then apply source location for scriptTimingInfo given handler.

algorithms.name: Report event listener
algorithms.html: To record timing info for event listener given an Event event and an EventListener listener: Create script entry point given listener’s relevant settings object, "`event-listener`", and the following steps given a script timing info scriptTimingInfo and a frame timing info frameTimingInfo:

steps.html: Set scriptTimingInfo’s event type to event’s type.
Let target be event’s currentTarget.
If target is a Node, then:
Set scriptTimingInfo’s invoker name to target’s nodeName.
If target is an Element, then:
Set scriptTimingInfo’s event target element id to target’s id.
Set scriptTimingInfo’s event target element src attribute to the result of getting an attribute value by name "`src`" and target.
Else, set scriptTimingInfo’s invoker name to target’s interface name.
Apply source location for scriptTimingInfo given listener’s callback.

If event is a UIEvent, and frameTimingInfo’s first ui event timestamp is null, then set frameTimingInfo’s first ui event timestamp to event’s relevant settings object’s time origin + a duration of event’s timeStamp milliseconds.

algorithms.name: Report promise resolver
algorithms.html: To record timing info for promise resolver given a Promise promise and a "`resolve-promise`" or "`reject-promise`" type:

steps.html: Create script entry point given promise’s relevant realm’s settings object, type, and the following steps given a script timing info scriptTimingInfo:
Set scriptTimingInfo’s invoker name to promise’s invoker name when created.
Set scriptTimingInfo’s source url to promise’s script url when created.
Set scriptTimingInfo’s source character position to promise’s source character position when created.
Set scriptTimingInfo’s source line number to promise’s source line when created.
Set scriptTimingInfo’s source column number to promise’s source column when created.

algorithms.name: Set source URL for script block
algorithms.html: To set source url for script block given a script timing info scriptTimingInfo, a script script, and a URL-or-null url:

steps.html: Set scriptTimingInfo’s source character position to 0.
If url is null, then return.
If url’s scheme is "`http`", "`https`", or "`blob`", then set scriptTimingInfo’s source url to the serialization of url.
Otherwise, if url’s scheme is "`data`", then set scriptTimingInfo’s source url to "`data:`".
If script is not a classic script whose muted errors is true, then:
Set scriptTimingInfo’s source line number to 1.
Set scriptTimingInfo’s source column number to 1.

algorithms.name: Report classic script execution
algorithms.html: To record classic script creation time given a classic script script and a URL-or-null originalSourceURL:

steps.html: Set script’s original source URL to originalSourceURL.

Create script entry point given script’s settings object, "`classic-script`", and the following step given a script timing info scriptTimingInfo: Set source url for script block given scriptTimingInfo, script, and script’s exposed source URL.

algorithms.name: Report classic script execution start
algorithms.html: To record classic script execution start time given a classic script script:

steps.html: Let settings be script’s settings object.
If settings’s global object is not a Window, then return.
Let document be settings’s global object’s associated Document.
Let frameTimingInfo be document’s relevant frame timing info.
If frameTimingInfo is null or frameTimingInfo’s pending script is null:

Create script entry point given settings, "`classic-script`", and the following step given a script timing info scriptTimingInfo: Set source url for script block given scriptTimingInfo, script, and script’s exposed source URL.
Return.
If script’s muted errors is false and the running script is null, then set frameTimingInfo’s pending script’s execution start time to the unsafe shared current time.

algorithms.name: Create script entry point
algorithms.html: To create script entry point given an environment settings object settings, a ScriptInvokerType invokerType, and steps, which is an algorithm that takes a script timing info and an optional frame timing info:

steps.html: If settings is not a Window, then return.
Let document be settings’s document.
Let didStartRecording be the result of calling start recording task time if needed given settings.
Let frameTimingInfo be document’s relevant frame timing info.
If frameTimingInfo is null, then return.
Set frameTimingInfo’s script initiated to didStartRecording.
If frameTimingInfo’s pending script is not null, then return.
Let now be the unsafe shared current time.
Let scriptTimingInfo be a new script timing info whose start time is now, whose execution start time is now, and whose invoker type is invokerType.
Run steps given scriptTimingInfo and frameTimingInfo.
Set scriptTimingInfo’s window to settings.
Accumulate style and layout time given frameTimingInfo.
Push "`script`" onto frameTimingInfo’s style and layout stack.
Set frameTimingInfo’s pending script to scriptTimingInfo.

algorithms.name: Record timing info for microtask checkpoint
algorithms.html: To <dfn class="dfn-paneled has-dfn-panel" data-dfn-type="dfn" data-export="" id="record-timing-info-for-microtask-checkpoint" role="button" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0">record timing info for microtask checkpoint</dfn>:

steps.html: For each Document root whose relevant agent’s event loop is the surrounding agent’s event loop, and whose current frame timing info is not null and has a non-null pending script: Finish the pending script of root.

algorithms.name: Finish the pending script
algorithms.html: To finish the pending script of a Document root:

steps.html: Let frameTimingInfo be root’s current frame timing info.
Let scriptTimingInfo be frameTimingInfo’s pending script.
Accumulate style and layout time given frameTimingInfo.
Let popped be the result of popping from frameTimingInfo’s style and layout stack.
Assert: popped is "`script`", i.e. any style recalculation or layout forced by the script has ended.
Let endTime be the unsafe shared current time.
Set frameTimingInfo’s pending script to null.
Set scriptTimingInfo’s end time to endTime.
If the duration between scriptTimingInfo’s start time and scriptTimingInfo’s end time is greater than 5 milliseconds, then append scriptTimingInfo to frameTimingInfo’s scripts.
If frameTimingInfo is script initiated, then record task end time given endTime and root.

algorithms.name: Applying source location
algorithms.html: To apply source location to a script timing info scriptTimingInfo given a callback function or Function callback:

steps.html: If callback was not defined in a script, then return.
Let script be the script where callback was defined.
Let url be script’s exposed source URL.
If <var>url</var> is not null:
If url’s scheme is "`http`", "`https`", or "`blob`", then the user agent may set scriptTimingInfo’s source url to the serialization of url.
Otherwise, if url’s scheme is "`data`", then the user agent may set scriptTimingInfo’s source url to "`data:`".
If script is a classic script whose muted errors is true, then return.
The user agent may set scriptTimingInfo’s source function name to the function name of callback.
The user agent may set scriptTimingInfo’s source character position to the character position where callback was defined.
The user agent may set scriptTimingInfo’s source line number to the line number where callback was defined.
The user agent may set scriptTimingInfo’s source column number to the column number where callback was defined.

algorithms.name: Report pause duration
algorithms.html: To record pause duration given a duration duration:

steps.html: Let script be the running script.
If script is null, then return.
Let settings be script’s settings object.
If settings’s global object is not a Window, then return.
Let document be settings’s document.
Let frameTimingInfo be the relevant frame timing info given document.
If frameTimingInfo is null or frameTimingInfo’s pending script is null, then return.
Increment frameTimingInfo’s pending script’s pause duration by the milliseconds value of duration.

algorithms.name: Begin style or layout work
algorithms.html: To begin style or layout work given a Document document and a string type:

steps.html: Let timingInfo be document’s relevant frame timing info.
If timingInfo is null, then return.
Accumulate style and layout time given timingInfo.
Push type onto timingInfo’s style and layout stack.

algorithms.name: End style or layout work
algorithms.html: To end style or layout work given a Document document and a string type:

steps.html: Let timingInfo be document’s relevant frame timing info.
If timingInfo is null, then return.
Accumulate style and layout time given timingInfo.
Let popped be the result of popping from timingInfo’s style and layout stack.
Assert: popped is type.

algorithms.name: Accumulate style and layout time
algorithms.html: To accumulate style and layout time given a frame timing info timingInfo:

steps.html: Let now be the coarsened shared current time given timingInfo’s cross-origin isolated capability.
If timingInfo’s style and layout stack is not empty, then:
Let type be the result of peeking into timingInfo’s style and layout stack.
Let script be timingInfo’s pending script.
Let duration be the duration between timingInfo’s style and layout stack change time and now.
If type is "`style`" and script is not null, then increment script’s forced style duration by the milliseconds value of duration.
Otherwise, if type is "`layout`" and script is not null, then increment script’s forced layout duration by the milliseconds value of duration.

Otherwise, if type is "`style`" or "`layout`", then append a new style and layout period whose type is type, start time is timingInfo’s style and layout stack change time, and end time is now, to timingInfo’s style and layout periods.
Set timingInfo’s style and layout stack change time to now.

algorithms.name: Monkey patches to promise handling
algorithms.html:
The Promise interface has an associated string invoker name when created, initially "`Promise`". The Promise interface has an associated string script url when created, initially the empty string. The Promise interface has an associated number source character position when created, initially -1. The Promise interface has an associated number source line when created, initially -1. The Promise interface has an associated number source column when created, initially -1.

Append the following steps to creating a new promise, before returning the Promise:

Prepend the following step to resolve a promise given Promise p: Record timing info for promise resolver given p and "`resolve-promise`".

Prepend the following step to reject a promise given Promise p: Record timing info for promise resolver given p and "`reject-promise`".

steps.html: If this promise was created by the steps of an attribute, regular operation, or static operation member defined on an interface interface, then:
Let interfaceName be interface’s identifier.
Let memberName be member’s identifier.
The user agent may set the created Promise’s invoker name when created to the concatenation of « interfaceName, ".", memberName ».
Let script be the running script.
If <var>script</var> is not null:
Let url be script’s exposed source URL.
If <var>url</var> is not null:
If url’s scheme is "`http`", "`https`", or "`blob`", then the user agent may set the created Promise’s script url when created to the serialization of url.
Otherwise, if url’s scheme is "`data`", then the user agent may set the created Promise’s script url when created to "`data:`".
If script is not a classic script whose muted errors is true:
ignored: The user agent may set the created Promise’s source character position when created to the zero-based character position in script where the operation or attribute getter that created this promise was invoked. The user agent may set the created Promise’s source line when created to the one-based line number in script where the operation or attribute getter that created this promise was invoked. The user agent may set the created Promise’s source column when created to the one-based column number in script where the operation or attribute getter that created this promise was invoked.
